top_signals.title: Climate talks ditch call to quit fossil fuels as deal nears
top_signals.summary: Compromises on charged issues at the COP31 talks in Antalya, Turkey, raise the prospects for agreement on a broad, though watered-down deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
